subject.title: improve(setup): keep WSL operations inside the app-owned directory

question: Should standalone SetupEngine preserve existing custom distro names that resolve to a safe immediate child, or intentionally replace that contract with the new ASCII-only naming policy?
rationale: Preventing traversal does not require rejecting every space, Unicode character, or other filesystem-safe name, but intentionally imposing a stricter contract is a compatibility and security-policy choice.

options.title: Preserve safe names
options.body: Validate canonical immediate-child ownership, separators, reserved path forms, and reparse boundaries without rejecting other WSL-valid custom names.

options.title: Adopt strict names
options.body: Keep the ASCII-only policy, document it as an intentional breaking standalone SetupEngine contract, and add upgrade-focused compatibility proof.

recommendation.title: Preserve safe names
recommendation.body: Validate canonical immediate-child ownership, separators, reserved path forms, and reparse boundaries without rejecting other WSL-valid custom names.
